## Endpoints

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data for a specific item by its ID.
- `GET /jgp-service-api/display-views/groups` — Retrieve a list of display groups.
- `GET /jgp-service-api/display-views/groups/{groupId}/groupImage` — Get the image associated with a display group.

### Config (3)
- `GET /jgp-service-api/config/translations/languages` — Get available language codes for translations.
- `GET /jgp-service-api/config/translations/languages/SLO` — Get translations for a specific language (SLO).
- `GET /jgp/assets/config/{configId}` — Retrieve a specific configuration file by ID.
